description: 国王印度防御 E94 — 子力拥挤可视化：活动格计数

intro.popup_en: Space Cramping, Lesson 3: How can we measure congestion? Count the available squares for each knight. The larger the difference, the more severe the space disadvantage. Watch what happens to Black's knights after White advances d5.
intro.popup:
空间挤压 第3课

如何量化拥挤程度？

学习活动格计数法：
数一数每个马有多少个能走的格子
差距越大，挤压越严重！

跟踪白方d5推进后，
黑方的马发生了什么……

outro.popup_en: The white knight on d3 has about six active squares, while Black's knights on e7 and d7 have about three each. The d5 bind creates this difference: fewer available squares mean deeper space restriction.
outro.popup:
活动格计数结果

白方马（d3）：6个活动格
黑方马（e7，d7）：各约3个

d5绑定直接造成差距！

公式：活动格越少 = 被压迫越深

moves.popup_en: d4! White controls the center from the first move.
...Nf6! Black begins the hypermodern approach, controlling the center before occupying it.
moves.popup:
Nf6！超现代路线开始
控制中心而不急于占领

moves.popup_en: c4! White builds a broad center with c4 and d4.
...g6 prepares ...Bg7 and control of the long diagonal, a hallmark of the King's Indian.
moves.popup:
g6 准备Bg7对角线控制
国王印度的标志性走法

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops and supports the center.
...Bg7! The King's Indian bishop commands the long a1-h8 diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bg7！国王印度象！
长对角线a1-h8，透视力极强

moves.popup_en: e4! White establishes a powerful three-pawn center with d4, c4, and e4.
moves.popup:
e4！白方建立超强中心
d4+c4+e4，横跨中心三格！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's position and supports a future ...e5.

moves.popup: O-O 王车易位，王已安全

moves.popup_en: Be2 develops steadily and prepares White to castle.
moves.popup: Be2 稳固发展，准备入城

moves.popup_en: ...e5! Black occupies a central square. Both sides now have central pawns and the position is balanced.
moves.popup:
e5！黑方占领中心格！
双方都有中心兵——局面均衡

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and attacks d4. The knight still has several active squares.
moves.popup:
Nc6 发展马，攻击d4
此时Nc6还有不错的活动空间

moves.popup_en: d5!! White closes the center and divides the board. The position is split between White's queenside and Black's f5-f4 area. How many good squares remain for the knight on c6?
moves.popup:
d5！！关键战略推进！

白方用d5关上了中心的大门
棋盘被分成两半：
左翼(白)：d5之前全是白方领地
右翼(黑)：f5-f4区域是黑方活动区

⚠ 现在：Nc6的好格子还剩几个？

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7! The knight retreats from c6. White controls e5 and b4 is too far away, so the knight loses central influence and is forced to e7. This is the immediate effect of the d5 bind.
moves.popup:
Ne7！马从c6撤退！

c6马失去了中心控制力
好格e5被白方控制，b4太偏远
马只能退到e7！

这就是d5绑定的立竿见影效果

moves.popup_en: Ne1! White voluntarily reroutes the knight toward d3, then c5 or f4. Unlike Black's forced retreat to e7, White's maneuver has a clear plan and aims for a better square.
moves.popup:
Ne1！白马主动撤退！

为什么？白方是主动的：
撤退是为了重新部署到更好的格：
Ne1→d3→c5或f4！

对比黑方Ne7：被迫退，
白方Ne1：主动退，计划明确！

moves.popup_en: ...Nd7! Black's other knight also retreats because d5 restricts its useful squares. The knight has only a few good options, such as b6, b8, or f6, and is cramped.
moves.popup:
Nd7！黑方f6马也退了！

又一次退马！
因为d5把黑方好格全压住了

⚠ 活动格计数：
Nd7的好格：b6、b8、f6（受限）
约2-3个好格……很拥挤！

moves.popup_en: Nd3! White's knight reaches an excellent square with six or more active destinations, including c1, b4, c5, e5, f4, and f2. Black's knights on e7 and d7 have about three each. This difference in mobility measures the space squeeze created by d5.
moves.popup:
Nd3！白马到达绝佳格！

白马Nd3的活动格：
c1、b4、c5、e5、f4、f2……6个以上！

对比黑方Ne7+Nd7：各约3个

这就是d5绑定造成的空间压缩——
活动格的数量差距=空间挤压的程度！
